description: 維修員老陳（repairman_chen）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 維修員老陳

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. Old Chen, a sturdy middle-aged maintenance repairman, about six and a half heads tall: a worn grey-blue work coverall with the sleeves rolled, welding goggles pushed up on the forehead, a tool belt with wrenches, thick gloves, heavy work boots. Empty hands.
